6.3 Validation
Pt Lifetime: Spectroscopy yields , with residuals <5% against density functional
theory (DFT). FSUFT-U’s  fits, .
Contrast: FSUFT-U 2.0’s  overshot, corrected in 6.0 to , aligning with
Pt’s  and spectroscopy.
6.4 Why It Works
Unified Coupling:  ties electrons to the fluid, a consistent  from gauge
unification.
Scalable :  adapts to atomic energies, linking micro to macro (e.g.,  vs. 
).
Empirical Fit:  matches data, resolving gaps in QED-GR disconnects.
Fluid Coherence:  as effective binding energy unifies stability with spacetime’s flow, a leap
over CDM’s macro focus.
